releases.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
releases.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

releases.name: Cut Corner Renovations USSR
releases.summary:
Step into the gritty world of Cut Corner Renovations USSR, where every crumbling wall and leaking pipe tests your creativity. Take on the role of a handyman working with scarce resources as you repair old Soviet-era apartments and houses using whatever tools and materials you can find. Patch cracked walls, fix broken wiring, replace damaged floors, and restore rundown rooms while improvising solutions on a tight budget. In a world where nothing is ever straightforward, each repair demands clever thinking, patience, and resourcefulness. Can you keep these aging homes standing despite the odds?
Key Features:
• Repair Soviet-era houses and apartments using limited tools and scarce materials.
• Scavenge for usable parts and improvise creative solutions when resources fall short.
• Navigate unpredictable and quirky repair scenarios inspired by real USSR-era challenges.
• Manage your time and prioritize tasks to keep homes functional and safe.
• Experience a blend of humor, strategy, and realistic handyman work.
• Adapt, overcome obstacles, and prove you’re the ultimate low-budget home repair specialist.
Every cracked wall is a new test of your ingenuity.

releases.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
releases.summary:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA

releases.name: Backrooms: Escape
releases.summary:
Trapped. Alone. And something is watching you. Explore the endless Backrooms, survive what lurks inside, and find a way out before it finds you.

You weren’t supposed to end up here.
One wrong step and reality is gone. Now you’re trapped inside the Backrooms — an endless maze of empty rooms, buzzing lights, dark corridors, and places that feel disturbingly familiar.
There is a way out. Somewhere.
Explore unsettling environments, search for clues, navigate confusing corridors, and stay alert. The deeper you go, the less you can trust what you see — and you may not be alone.
ESCAPE THE BACKROOMS
Find your way through a labyrinth where every corridor can lead deeper into the unknown. Pay attention to your surroundings and search for the path forward.
SURVIVE THE UNKNOWN
Silence doesn’t mean safety. Strange entities may be closer than you think. Know when to move, when to hide, and when to run.
EXPLORE LIMINAL WORLDS
Wander through eerie rooms, endless hallways, abandoned spaces, and surreal environments inspired by the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms.
STAY ALERT
Every corner can hide a clue, a new path… or something you wish you hadn’t found.
CAN YOU FIND THE EXIT?
Enter the Backrooms and discover how far you’re willing to go to escape.

releases.name: Colorbound
releases.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

releases.name: Car Drift Simulator 2027
releases.summary:
Choose your car and start your drifting journey.

Feel the tires scream, the engine roar, and the asphalt disappear beneath you as you push every corner to the limit! Enter a high-speed world of precision drifting where split-second reactions, perfect control, and fearless driving are the keys to becoming a true drift master.

Choose your favorite car from the very beginning and hit the track with nothing holding you back. Throw your car into every corner, control the slide, balance the throttle, and chase the perfect drift as you take on increasingly demanding challenges. Every turn is an opportunity to prove your skill, and every mistake can cost you the perfect run.

Key Features:
• 5 Cars Available From the Start: Choose from 5 unique cars and start drifting immediately.
• 20 Challenging Levels: Master 20 tracks filled with demanding corners and technical turns.
• Advanced Drift Physics: Control every slide with responsive handling and realistic weight transfer.
• Master Every Curve: Improve your lines and drifting technique across every challenging track.
• Immersive Racing Audio: Feel every drift with roaring engines and screeching tires.

releases.name: Crazy Lamb RC
releases.summary:
A wild RC racing adventure with a lamb behind the handlebars!

Take control of a crazy toy trike and put your driving skills to the test with realistic physics and fast-paced RC racing.

Race against opponents, beat your best times in Time Trial, or explore freely in Free Roam. Play with a friend in 2-player split-screen or challenge them through Wireless Play!

Get behind the handlebars and let the crazy RC racing begin!

releases.name: Rusty Prison: Horror
releases.summary:
You probably shouldn't be here.

You found an abandoned prison.

Naturally, you decided to explore it.

Rusty Prison: Horror is a creepy exploration game where you wander through a forgotten, rust-covered prison looking for something cool to find. Explore dark cells, strange rooms, broken hallways, and places that probably should have stayed locked.

releases.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
releases.summary:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow.

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighbourhood!

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone.

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places.

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op.

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas.

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.

releases.name: Sugar Rush Rescue
releases.summary:
A tasty, retro co-op adventure.

When best friends Colby and Jack find a forest of candy, they're ready to munch! But while the boys selfishly sample the sweets, Colby's little sister is abducted by a monstrous owl! Now they must navigate a world of confections as they learn to pay attention to what matters most.

Featuring a wide range of obstacles, enemies, and levels to explore, Sugar Rush Rescue is a tasty, retro co-op adventure.

releases.name: Wrap House Simulator
releases.summary: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

releases.name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
releases.summary: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

releases.name: PARCEL INSPECTION SIMULATOR
releases.summary:
Inspect every parcel and keep the deliveries moving.

Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly.

From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

Key Features:
• Receive and Sort Parcels – Manage the full parcel workflow: accept shipments, sort them correctly, and prepare them for the next stage of processing.
• Inspect Documents Carefully – Verify sender and recipient information, identify incorrect data, and prevent costly mistakes.
• Multiple Inspection Methods – Use different tools and checking methods to ensure every parcel meets the correct requirements.
• Upgrade Your Workspace – Expand your inspection area, upgrade equipment, and improve your parcel processing system.
• Increasing Workload – Handle more packages and more complex tasks as operations grow busier and more demanding.
• Build an Efficient Operation – Start with a small inspection point and develop it into a well-organized parcel management system.

releases.name: Cozy Meowmory
releases.summary:
Build the purr-fect room and spot what’s out of place!

KEEP YOUR CAT EYES SHARP
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

TRUST YOUR MEOWMORY
Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

CREATE YOUR PURR-FECT ROOM
Take a break from puzzling and become an interior designer! Build your own cozy rooms from scratch and make them truly yours with over 870 customization items, including furniture, decorations, plants, floors, walls and more! Arrange everything just the way you like, experiment with colors and create a cozy space for your feline friends. Collect 2 adorable kitties and watch them wander around the room as you enjoy your creation.

TWO PLAYERS, TWICE THE PURR
Challenge a friend in local multiplayer and see who can spot the differences faster! Play together on one screen, put your observation skills to the test and turn every cozy room into a little friendly competition.

releases.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
releases.summary:
DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic, take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

Kill bugs, upgrade your gear, and delve ever deeper into the lethal caves of Hoxxes. Collect and assemble a devastating array of guns, unleash hell upon wave after wave of alien monsters in fast and frenetic combat, and tunnel your way to collect precious riches from deep within the cave walls. Each mission is unique, using procedural cave generation and enemy waves, just as you've come to know from Deep Rock Galactic.

releases.name: Rhythm Roll
releases.summary: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

releases.name: Hidden Objects
releases.summary:
The game Find Object offers you an incredible trip around the world. Try to find objects in Paris and visit Antartida. Appreciate the castles of Germany or collect luggage at the airport.

We have prepared a good graphic content for you. The peculiarity of our hidden object game is that the objects you need to find are hidden inside. Finding items in our game will give you a really great aesthetic pleasure.

We have made a variety of items to find, and we have hidden them well. We have added variations of items and made finding items really interesting. You should try it.

For those who like adventure and looking for items, we have tried to hide these items well. Will you be able to find them?

releases.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West
releases.summary: The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

releases.name: Heroic Songs: The Remix
releases.summary:
An idol x city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!

The adventure begins in a blank, open field beneath the World Tree. From roads to buildings, you’ll place a wide variety of structures to gather resources and grow your city into a thriving sanctuary.

As the Fanctuary develops, you’ll attract more fans, earn Likes, and unlock new concerts. You can even build stages where your idols will perform in front of cheering crowds!

releases.name: Deck of Haunts
releases.summary:
Step into the role of a sinister Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence.

By day, meticulously design the labyrinthine layout of your mansion, transforming it into a death trap that no human can escape. As night falls, lure unwitting explorers into your home, where you'll use a deck of terrifying cards to summon spirits, shift hallways, and unleash spine-chilling horrors. Build tension and drive your guests toward madness, all while protecting your Heart room - the core of your malevolent power.

Once their sanity crumbles, harvest their essence to strengthen your mansion, increasing your infamy and attracting even more daring foes, from law enforcement to priests. But beware, the Stone Masons are coming, ready to challenge your reign of terror...

releases.name: Silver Pines
releases.summary:
Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines, a place half-abandoned, half-forgotten, in the middle of nowhere on a job to track down Eddie Velvet. A musician who has vanished. As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

releases.name: Manairons
releases.summary: The Manairons are back… and this time, they’re not staying quiet! Manairons is a 3D action platformer game set in the Pyrenees, where ancient legends mix with smoking factories, mischievous magic, and quirky little creatures. You are Nai, a manairó who has just awakened from centuries locked in the ""canut"", a magical artifact as old as it is suspicious. A witch frees you (very timely, indeed) and gives you a mission: recover the "canut" and stop the chaos it’s causing. The culprit? Llorenç, a landowner with zero charisma and a lot of machines. He’s used the power of the manairons to industrialize the peaceful village of Vilamont. Shops are closed, people are hiding at home, and your fellow manairons are working as if there’s no tomorrow… This is not what the legends said! But Nai isn’t going to sit back. With the help of ancient magical melodies (and a few poorly played notes), you’ll control your fellow manairons, solve puzzles that’ll make you scratch your head, and face your own kind who are working for Llorenç—all with the flute! Adventure, action, stressed-out little creatures, and more than a few hidden secrets await you in the mountains. And remember: when a manairó gets mad… it’s best to step aside. Key Features: - Businesses: Explore the most important businesses of Vilamont, each with its own style and unique challenges. - Magical Melodies: Learn and play different melodies to solve puzzles that will test your creativity and problem-solving skills. - Flute Combat:Face off against other Manairons with your flute. Knock them out or send them to sleep! - Unique Bosses: Defeat the bosses of each zone to progress in the story and free the Manairons. - Tons of Secrets: Each business hides secrets waiting to be uncovered. Are you brave enough to find them all?
